name: Hero (knight)
description: a broad-shouldered armoured knight of average adult height in full plate armour of nearly black dark steel with a reddish-brown sheen and bright steel highlights on the edges; a rounded dome great helm with a single narrow horizontal visor slit and a raised central ridge, no face visible; layered pauldrons, a breastplate with a shallow X-shaped ridge, articulated plate gauntlets, plate greaves and sabatons; red-brown leather straps and a wide red-brown leather belt with a dark buckle; a short tattered red-brown leather tasset skirt over a chainmail skirt reaching mid-thigh; a dark crimson cloth cape draped over both shoulders like a mantle, hanging to the back of the knees with a ragged, torn hem; both hands empty, no weapon, no shield
